raw_segments.text: Leance is whispering nothing, is leaning cheek-to-cheek, is meeting noses, kissing with inside lip,
stopping the career of laughter with a sigh, a note infallible of breaking honesty, horsing
foot on foot, skulking in corners, wishing clocks more swift, hours, minutes, noon, midnight,
and all eyes blind with the pin and web but theirs, theirs only that would unseen be wicked.
Why then the world and all that's int is nothing.
The covering sky is nothing, bohemia nothing, my wife is nothing, nor nothing have these
